PROCEDURE PP_MOSTRAR_DESC_SECCION IS

BEGIN
  SELECT SECC_DESC
  INTO  :BDOCU.S_DESC_SECCION
  FROM  GEN_SECCION
  WHERE SECC_DPTO  = :BDOCU.DOCU_DPTO
    AND SECC_CODIGO  = :BDOCU.DOCU_SECCION;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
     :BDOCU.S_DESC_SECCION := NULL;
END;

FUNCTION FP_COSTO_TOTAL RETURN NUMBER IS
  CostoTot NUMBER;
BEGIN
	
SELECT 	
	SUM(
	DECODE(AEP_COSTO_PROM_MON, 0 , NVL(AEP_COSTO_PROV, AEP_COSTO_PROM_MON), AEP_COSTO_PROM_MON) * DETA_CANT )
    INTO CostoTot
   FROM STK_ART_EMPR_PERI, STK_DOCUMENTO_DET
   WHERE DETA_CLAVE_DOC = :BDOCU.DOCU_CLAVE
     AND AEP_PERIODO = :BDOCU.W_PERIODO
     AND AEP_EMPR = :PARAMETER.P_EMPRESA
     AND AEP_ART = DETA_ART;
  RETURN CostoTot;
RETURN NULL; EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    RETURN 0;
END;
